choices.why: This three-seat sofa with track arms comes in an off-white fabric with light birch legs, a clean Nordic look that suits the left wall.
The green wingback armchair is a classic reading chair, brings the touch of green the user asked for, and has light wood legs.
This square coffee table in light ash is Nordic in style and sized well for between the sofa and the armchair.
At 200x300 cm this plain beige flatweave rug is big enough to anchor the seating area in warm cream tones.
This is the largest table on offer (140 cm), it seats six, and it is in the same light ash as the coffee table.
These light beech chairs with woven cord seats are warm and Nordic, and they match the light wood of the table.
The woven bamboo pendant adds natural texture and warm light over the dining table.
Its swing arm aims the light where it is needed, which is ideal for reading in the armchair.
This sideboard has light herringbone-wood doors on an off-white body, so it keeps the light palette of the dining area.
These light white linen curtains filter the light without darkening the window wall.
Green cushions on the off-white sofa repeat the colour of the armchair and add the green the user wanted.
A cream cable-knit throw adds warmth and texture to the sofa.
The tall areca palm fills the corner between the living and dining areas and brings in plenty of green.
Two black-and-white tree-line prints side by side cover the width of the sofa with a quiet Nordic feel.
This ceramic vase with embossed leaves, in cream and soft green, ties together the palette the user asked for.

answer.why: Light ash and beech, cream textiles and touches of green (armchair, cushions, palm, vase) create a warm, cohesive Nordic look that brightens the long room against the darker floor.
